source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The historical updater init returns !didFetch, which its caller treats as a request to use stored notifications. The newer accepted init returns {loadFromCache, hasCache}; the controller destructures both and decides whether to use stored or offline defaults. For this multi-outcome API, named result fields make the decision contract clear. Do not infer that a successful fetch also completed durable disk writes.
title: Return named cache decisions rather than an inverted success boolean
